items.stem: Which TWO are good sprint practices in Jira? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Commit to a sprint scope from a prioritised backlog
options.rationale: Correct: sprint planning draws from a ranked backlog.

options.text: Keep the sprint scope stable once committed
options.rationale: Correct: protecting the commitment supports a predictable sprint.

options.text: Add new stories into the active sprint whenever asked
options.rationale: Uncontrolled additions undermine the sprint commitment.

options.text: Delete the backlog after each sprint
options.rationale: The backlog persists and is re-prioritised, not deleted.

items.explanation: Correct: sprint planning draws from a ranked backlog.
